title: Crypto Job Inbox
intro: Ten job messages landed at once. Which are scams?
Swipe left if it is a scam, right if it is safe. Or tap the buttons.
Careful: some are honest. Do not cry wolf.

cards.text: Moderators wanted. Buy a 50 USDT starter token to activate your account.
cards.why: Real jobs never charge you to start.

cards.text: Thanks for your interview on Tuesday. Your contract is attached in the careers portal. No payment needed.
cards.why: You applied and interviewed, and nothing is asked of you.

cards.text: Like 10 videos, get 5 USDT. Join the private chat.
cards.why: Pay for likes plus a private chat is a task scam.

cards.text: Offer: 7,500 USDT a month. Buy your laptop from our vendor first.
cards.why: No employer makes you buy equipment from its vendor.

cards.text: Your pay slip for October is ready in your employee portal.
cards.why: A normal notice that points to the portal you already use.

cards.text: Deposit 100 USDT to prove your trading skills. Refunded later.
Hi, I saw your profile. Want a quick call tomorrow about a role? Reply yes or no.
cards.why: A normal recruiter approach with no money and no pressure.

cards.text: Your balance is negative. Top up 300 USDT to withdraw.
cards.why: Paying to withdraw your own pay is a trap.

cards.text: Reminder: team stand-up moved to 10:30, same link as always.
cards.why: An ordinary work note with no ask.

cards.text: Receive USDT in your wallet and forward it to us. Keep 5%.
cards.why: Forwarding money for strangers makes you a money mule.

golden_rule: A job that asks you to pay, deposit or forward money is a scam.

quick_check.q: Which message is the safest to answer?

options.text: Buy a starter token to activate
A recruiter asks for a quick call and nothing else

quick_check.explain: No money is asked and no pressure is applied.
